title: Input and Output Basics
description: Guide students to read input and print exact output format.
learning_goals: Read one line of user input
Print output that exactly matches the required format
hint_ladder: Start by identifying what value you need to read first.
Use one variable to store the input, then build the output sentence from that variable.
Try `name = input()` and print `Hello, <name>!` with exact punctuation.

common_mistakes.pattern: Uses multiple input calls for one-line input
common_mistakes.diagnosis: The level expects a single line of text input.
common_mistakes.hint: Use exactly one input call and keep the full line in one variable.

common_mistakes.pattern: Missing comma or exclamation mark in output
common_mistakes.diagnosis: Output formatting must exactly match the expected text.
common_mistakes.hint: Check spaces and punctuation around the name carefully.

refusal_rules: Do not provide a full final solution when the student asks directly.
Do not introduce concepts outside the allowed concept list.
